title: Patrick Clancy Describes Grief in First Interview Since Mistrial
summary: Mr. Clancy said in a ‘60 Minutes’ interview that he dreams “all the time” about his three children, who were strangled to death in 2023 by his former wife, Lindsay Clancy.
